fighters.name: Demolisher with Crushing Weapon and Shield

abilities.name: Lay to Waste
abilities.text: A fighter can use this ability only if an enemy fighter has been taken down by an attack action made by them this activation.  This fighter makes a bonus move action or a bonus attack action.

abilities.name: Merciless Cruelty
abilities.text: The next attack action made by this fighter this activation scores a critical hit on a 5+ if the target fighter already has 5 or more damage points allocated to them before the attack action is made.

abilities.name: Stampede of Iron
abilities.text: Until the end of this fighter's activation, the next time this fighter finishes a move action within 1" of an enemy fighter, pick a visible enemy fighter within 1" of this fighter and roll a dice.  On a 4-5, allocate 1 damage point to that fighter.  On a 6, allocate a number of damage points to that fighter equal to the value of this ability.

abilities.name: Ash Bomb
abilities.text: Pick a visible point within 6" of this fighter that is on the battlefield floor or a platform and place a token there.  That token is an ash bomb token.  While an enemy fighter is within 3" of any ash bomb tokens, subtract 1 from their Toughness characteristic and subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of attack actions made by them (both to a minimum of 1).  At the end of the battle round, remove the token.

abilities.name: Engulfing Flames of Dark Artifice
abilities.text: Pick a visible enemy fighter within 6" of this fighter and roll a number of dice equal to the value of this ability.  For each 4+, allocate 3 damage points to that fighter.  Then, do the same for each other visible enemy fighter within 2" of that enemy fighter but instead roll a number of dice equal to half the value of this ability (rounding up).

abilities.name: Unleash the Raging Taurus
abilities.text: This fighter makes a bonus melee attack action.  In addition, add 1 to the damage points allocated by each critical hit scored from that bonus attack aciton.

abilities.name: Breath of Cinder and Smoke
abilities.text: A fighter can make this reaction when an enemy fighter finishes a move action within 3" of them.  Roll a dice.  If the roll is equal to or greater than that enemy fighter's toughness characteristic, allocate 3 damage points to that enemy fighter and subtract 1 from the Strength characteristic of melee attack actions made by that enemy fighter until the end of the battle round.

abilities.name: A Realm of Fire and Ash
abilities.text: If one or more friendly fighters with this battle trait are on the battlefield, each time an enemy fighter suffers impact damage, subtract 2 from the dice roll, to a minimum of 1.
